gaps: no node, environment, network context, or fleet dimensions
no time-series retention; uptime is explicitly unknown
observability_coverage_percent uses a fixed six-item host-only denominator and returned 100 percent despite fleet blind spots
command permission failure is collapsed into false/absent state; non-root wg observation reported mesh_absent while root probes proved healthy mesh
current local executable declaration had a path mismatch, so the surface cannot assert installed runtime artifact identity
no normalised per-plane/service samples, freshness budget, or retention
not yet retained/rolled up into a fleet time series
not linked to execution context and network attachment
view persistence is not an observability history contract
no fleet aggregation or sample freshness SLO

existing_surfaces.surface: enrollment, build, release, and proof read-backs
gaps: timestamps/evidence refs exist but no common metric sample envelope
no cross-layer cardinality or outcome aggregation

false_or_unsafe_interpretations.finding: Host-only six-surface coverage is rendered as observability coverage, causing a 100 percent result despite absent fleet/network/service coverage.
false_or_unsafe_interpretations.required_rule: Coverage denominator must be declared by scope and dimensions; a host-local numerator never represents fleet coverage.

false_or_unsafe_interpretations.finding: Permission-denied WireGuard observation becomes mesh_absent rather than unknown_or_unobservable.
false_or_unsafe_interpretations.required_rule: Probe outcome must distinguish measured failure, unavailable capability, denied authority, timeout, and unknown.

false_or_unsafe_interpretations.finding: One-shot observations are consumed as health-like state while uptime and availability require a retained sample sequence.
false_or_unsafe_interpretations.required_rule: Single sample proves only its timestamped observation; availability requires a declared window and complete sample cadence.

false_or_unsafe_interpretations.finding: CLI surface names are inconsistent: runtime metrics exists but runtime network does not; network runtime is separate.
false_or_unsafe_interpretations.required_rule: A metric catalog must map every sample producer to one canonical read-only projection.

non_goals: do not introduce Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or a time-series database before the typed sample and retention contracts exist
do not turn raw command stdout into a durable metric schema
do not coerce unavailable or permission-denied data into zero or failed health
